title: [6/10/2024] The percentage of five kinds of books sold by a bookseller
prompt: The pie charts below show the percentage of five kinds of books sold by a bookseller between 1972 and 2012. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie charts illustrate the proportions of five different book categories sold by a bookseller between 1972 and 2012.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, both fiction categories showed upward trends over the 40-year period, while biography, travel, and other types of books declined. In addition, adult fiction dominated the market by 2012, accounting for nearly half of all books sold.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two main fiction categories, adult fiction and children's fiction each represented 20% of total sales in 1972. While adult fiction's share rose steadily to 25% in 1992 and then surged to 45% by 2012, children's fiction showed only a slight increase to 22% in 1992 before maintaining a relatively stable share of 25% in the final year.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining categories, biography also made up 20% of sales in 1972, followed by travel at 15% and other types at 25%. Biography's proportion declined gradually to 15% and then dropped further to just 8% by 2012. Meanwhile, travel books showed some fluctuation, rising slightly to 18% in 1992 before falling to 10% in 2012, while the share of other books decreased consistently, ending at 12% in the final year.
